item.title: A Quick Guide to Cleaning Economic Microdata
item.author: 1450169683@qq.com (滑翔闪)
item.description: This post introduces the main social survey databases in China, along with commonly used Stata data-cleaning and descriptive-statistics code. It also records many data-cleaning problems I ran into, such as Excel-related handling.
